f.title: Report ADRs and other listed safety events for all products
f.statement: For all products the following should be reported: adverse drug reactions from non-prescription and prescription drugs (including biological and radiopharmaceutical products); adverse reactions from herbal medicinal products, food supplements, medical devices, cosmetics and household chemical substances; drug abuse, overdose, interactions, quality defects, poor packaging, questionable stability, suspected contamination, suspected counterfeit and lack of therapeutic efficacy; adverse events from products used in phase IV clinical studies; and adverse reactions in recipients of blood or blood components.

f.title: Communicate contradicting, harm or lack-of-effect information to FDA within 7 calendar days

f.title: Longer-cycle PSUR/PBRER accepted where FDA requires a six-month local cycle
f.statement: Where an MAH prepares PSURs/PBRERs annually or over longer periods for other authorities based on the IBD, and the Authority requires a six-month cycle based on the local birth date, the most recent PSUR/PBRER covering the longer period will be acceptable to the Authority. The Authority may also request ad hoc PSURs/PBRERs when there are new or changed risks, changed efficacy/effectiveness or changes to the benefit-risk profile.
